recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-38940; avoid rewriting Bundle search-parameter expressions under this issue because they are outside the constraint-expression cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-38940 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking that Bundle constraint FHIRPath expressions consistently refer to local elements rather than mixing Bundle.[element], %resource.[element], and unqualified [element] forms.
initial_application: The Jira comment linked HL7/fhir#2428. Commit 9d62b7791f99105778f23844e42d13f7ae60eec9 initially changed Bundle constraints from %resource.type and Bundle.issues toward unqualified type and issues; merge commit 0bf45b6fab56d2e4958f3852b7fc0f529472a2c6 brought that PR into the main history. Commit 1b2d9f9e248c7fc83375414cd62617e2c3500c50 then reverted the old bdl-3/bdl-4 %resource.type replacements because the unqualified type path was not in context inside entry.all().
additional_context: FHIR-38942 later split the old bdl-3/bdl-4 rules into bdl-3a through bdl-3d, removing the obsolete %resource.type pattern from the active constraints while preserving semantics. source/fhir.ini actively registers Bundle, and current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml has Bundle constraints bdl-1 through bdl-18 using unqualified local paths. Remaining qualified Bundle.* expressions in the Bundle directory are search-parameter expressions, not constraints. An exact Zulip search for FHIR-38940 found no relevant community discussion, while FHIR-I minutes confirm the 14-0-0 Persuasive vote.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current authoritative Bundle StructureDefinition already satisfies the Jira's consistency goal and avoids the old invalid unqualified-path context issue.

related_jiras.note: Later Bundle invariant work split the old bdl-3/bdl-4 rules into bdl-3a through bdl-3d, which supports the current no-change conclusion for FHIR-38940.

evidence_items.summary: Initial FHIR-38940 commit changed Bundle constraints from %resource.type and Bundle.issues toward type and issues.
